extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1980s full-size passenger van, approx. 4.9 x 2.05 x 1.93 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors), wheel diameter 0.66 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic boxy 1980s van with short hood, two-tone side band and a sliding door shown by seams and rail (not movable); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow interior with transparent windows, seats, two bench rows and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
